title: Account Sign Up & Merchant Store Setup Walkthrough
description: Step-by-step video guide covering account registration, SMS OTP verification, QR login, and merchant store setup.

segments.title: Account Sign Up & Credentials
segments.summary: The user opens the application, taps the "Sign Up" button, and enters basic personal information including their Full Name, Phone Number, and a secure Password to initiate the registration process.
segments.transcript: The user opens the application, taps the Sign Up button, and enters basic personal information including their Full Name, Phone Number, and a secure Password to initiate the registration process.
possible_questions: Where do I click to start signing up?
What details do I need to enter to create a new account?
Can I use my phone number as my username?

segments.title: SMS Verification & QR Backup
segments.summary: The user receives a 6-digit SMS verification code, enters it into the app, and confirms success. Following this, the user downloads and stores a security QR code for future account access.
segments.transcript: The user receives a 6-digit SMS verification code, enters it into the app, and confirms success. Following this, the user downloads and stores a security QR code for future account access.
possible_questions: How do I verify my phone number?
Why do I need to download a QR code?
What happens if I lose my QR code?

segments.title: Secure Login
segments.summary: The user views the login options and selects the QR code method. They scan the previously saved QR code using the app's camera viewfinder to successfully log in and access the main dashboard.
segments.transcript: The user views the login options and selects the QR code method. They scan the previously saved QR code using the app's camera viewfinder to successfully log in and access the main dashboard.
possible_questions: How do I log in using the QR code?
Where is the camera scanner located?
What do I do after scanning the QR code?

segments.title: Business Registration & Store Setup
segments.summary: The user selects "Register as Business Owner," fills in the required store details including Shop Name, Category, and Address, and submits the application to complete the setup.
